responsibility: Shared implementation of language hooks and utilities used by both the C++ and Objective-C++ front ends. It provides C++-aware alias-set rules, tree-node sizing for cp-specific node kinds, type-compatibility and variably-modified-type checks, debug-info type and DWARF attribute adjustments, builtin-name recognition, dump registration, tree-code initialization for cp-specific AST nodes, and shared option handling such as contract-related front-end switches.
same_name_distinction: Provides the actual shared C++/Objective-C++ hook implementations, such as tree sizing, alias-set logic, debug/DWARF adjustments, dump registration, tree-code initialization, and option handling. Unlike cp-objcp-common.h, it is not the LANG_HOOKS wiring header but the code behind those common hooks.
